_doc: R30-6 (task #455) — A/B/B/A paired judge config: measures the mixed small+large-object churn latency win/loss across the large-cache headroom_bytes sweep {0, 16, 64, 256 MiB} through the REAL #[global_allocator] entry point (mirrors R27-4's own real-default AB gate shape, generalized from 2 arms to 4). Each binary is a SEPARATE compile-time-configured static (SeferAlloc::with_config bakes LargeCacheConfig at compile time — the same structural reason R27-4 needed separate cap4/cap8 binaries). Driven by: node scripts/paired-ab-runner.mjs --config docs/perf/r30_6_latency_run.json --arms h256,hN for each hN in {h0,h16,h64}.

sanity._doc_sanity: Both arms install a REAL SeferAlloc #[global_allocator] and run a mixed small+large workload that reserves segments, so BOTH must report segments_reserved_total > 0.
